claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pargyline is a monoamine oxidase inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent in a 5-day pooled viability screen, since MAO inhibition is not directly lethal to cancer cells and no off-target cytotoxic mechanism is evident at this concentration.
